objects.meaning: A purchasable catalog item with identity, descriptive attributes, price, and availability-related state.
An ordered or segmented set of products produced by browsing or search criteria.
A customer identity and authenticated shopping context.
The current set of intended purchases before order submission.
The preparation state that gathers the information required to submit a purchase.
A submitted purchase with a stable identity, status, monetary values, items, and customer information.
The customer account history containing zero or more orders.
